summary: @or-sdk/providers preinstall executes an obfuscated 727KB payload via a downloaded Bun runtime
details: package.json declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x`-prefixed identifiers, per-function string-alias decoy objects wrapping execFileSync) and, on install, downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 as a platform-specific ZIP from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte Bun-only bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) heavily obfuscated with a shuffled numeric/string constant table and a `WV8StW(arr,n)` rotation function, and is ships at the tarball root while being undeclared in package.json (no `files` field) and unreferenced by README or by any source/dist file other than setup.mjs. The advertised package purpose is a small (~9KB TypeScript) API-SDK wrapper around EventManager/Discovery clients — nothing in that purpose requires a downloaded second-language runtime or a large obfuscated bundle. The combination — obfuscated preinstall driver, download of an alien runtime specifically to execute an undocumented obfuscated blob at install time, and an installed-payload shape that evades Node-based scanners — is the alternate-runtime-dropper attack pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
